claim_boundary: height admission conditional on public hit; charge public search and all lift candidates; no same-target online speedup inference
controls: one first nonhit per target; all 27 variants retained
falsifiers: public relation disagrees with scalar congruence
second reduction match disagrees with public relation
generator_law: first x ascending, y ascending, whose cofactor multiple has order q
lift_phase: each public hit and first public nonhit per target: S=b^-1 U, centered x,y, shifts kx,ky,kA in {-1,0,1}; A=-1+kA*p; B=y^2-x^3-A*x; T=(x,y), P=b*T, R=-a*T
public_phase: test every vector on every query before lift selection; retain 6656 rows
query_law: first 16 lexicographic ordered distinct offset pairs with U=Q-t1G and V=Q-t2G both nonidentity
score: max numerator or denominator bits of A,B,Px,Py,Rx,Ry
